question.en: Discuss the role of National Investment and Manufacturing Zones (NIMZs) in achieving the objectives of the 'Make in India' initiative.
question.hi: Discuss the role of National Investment and Manufacturing Zones (NIMZs) in achieving the objectives of the 'Make in India' initiative.

modelAnswer.en: NIMZs act as industrial townships with world-class infrastructure, reducing logistics costs, promoting ease of doing business, and creating large-scale employment, which are central to the Make in India vision.
